appraisal_events.evidence: Ah ! Robert, qu’on est bien chez vous... comme il serait bon qu’il fût permis d’y dîner et d’y coucher !; ... quel repos sans tristesse j’aurais goûté là, protégé par cette atmosphère de tranquillité, de vigilance et de gaieté...
appraisal_events.explanation: After a long meditation with no named characters, the narrator directly voices warm admiration for Saint-Loup's room and the orderly, cheerful barracks life around him, framing his space as an ideal refuge.

status_effects.explanation: Saint-Loup gains a mild positive halo from the narrator's explicit, direct praise of his room and the enviable calm of the world he inhabits.
